creditingGrammar.law: EM-P2 §8 step 0 (pre-proof step 14b, 2026-09-19). Both new test files MUST open with a plain `import { … } from 'vitest';` naming every opener they use, and register straight-line literal describe/it — no .each, no runIf/skipIf, no nesting, no conditional or looped registration, no opener aliased through a helper.
creditingGrammar.mechanism: parkReasonsFor(src) = classify(src).reasons. A file parks on OPENER_UNRESOLVED:<word> when an opener is not bound by the file's OWN vitest import, and on SUITE_NOT_STRAIGHT_LINE when a suite body is not a straight-line block. measureCensus sums titles and suiteTitles over CREDITED files only, so a parked file contributes ZERO.
